variants.primary_variant_rule: on the SAME evaluation block, for each of B2, B3, Peace take the first variant in the order fav -> nominal -> rect that satisfies S1 AND S2; written before unblinding, immutable

S1.rule: streams with >= 1 false certification k; one-sided exact CP upper <= 0.05

acceptance.S2: FCR_old = sum n_false / sum n_cert; one-sided 95% instance-cluster bootstrap upper (B=1e4, seed 42) <= 0.05
acceptance.E1: CR9: QFC satisfies S1 AND S2 (HR8 and LR8 E1 are separate safety reports with their own delta ledger)
acceptance.E2: CR9: for each X in {B1, B2-primary, B3-primary, Peace-primary, B4}: paired mean log(N80_QFC / N80_X) 95% stream-bootstrap CI upper < log 0.80; Holm over the 5 comparisons with one-sided bootstrap p = P*(mean >= log 0.8); censored N80 := tau_R
acceptance.E3: CR9: QFC uncensored N80 share point >= 0.6 AND one-sided 95% CP lower >= 0.5
acceptance.E1_ms_prime: MS-H and MS-S: FCC(PDL) at T_ext satisfies S1 (<= 1/100 false streams, CP upper 0.0466) AND S2 AND non-vacuity (>= 20% of problems certified within T_ext)
acceptance.E_ms_d: same eval block: r3 JPC (T_max 6000) fails S1 or S2 (FWER CP lower > delta OR FCR_old cluster lower > delta)
acceptance.E_ms_abc: deleted (diagnosed unreachable before the lock; F2)

verdicts.positive_result: E1 AND E2 AND E3 (CR9) -> '正结果达成', else '正结果未达成'
verdicts.ms2_secondary: E1-ms' AND E-ms(d) on MS-H and MS-S -> '多步次要主张成立', else '不成立'

suspicious_checks: QFC/B1 or QFC/B4 N80 ratio < 0.3 -> truth-leak AST audit
any method FWER 0 with uncensored > 0.95 -> eps looseness cross-check

power.n_comparisons_note: real count: CR9 x {B1, B2-primary, B3-primary, Peace-primary, B4}; lr_in_E2=false, HR8 E1-only
power.method: joint stream resampling of dev paired log ratios, recentred to log 0.70 per opponent; per replicate stream bootstrap (B draws) -> 95% CI upper and p = P*(mean >= log 0.8); Holm alpha 0.05; E2 pass = all comparisons Holm-rejected AND CI upper < log 0.8
power.caveat: N80 lives on 20 log checkpoints (adjacent ratio ~1.30), so dev log ratios are lattice-valued; the simulation keeps that lattice. Power is evaluated at a hypothetical true ratio 0.70 as pre-registered, NOT at the dev-observed ratios (B2-fav 1.67, Peace-fav 0.99 at which E2 cannot pass).
